name: Nantucket County, MA
findings: Nantucket County has 67 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Nantucket County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Nantucket County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 21% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 21% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
